entries.title: 模型目录与 API 价格对比上线
entries.title_en: Model Catalog and API Price Comparison Are Live
entries.summary: 新增按模型浏览与独立 API 价格页，套餐适配关系和模型使用成本可以在同一站点交叉比较。
entries.summary_en: Browse plans by model and compare official API prices on a dedicated page, bringing model availability and usage cost into one workflow.
items: 订阅套餐新增“按模型”维度，可反查每个模型对应的可用套餐。
新增模型价格对比页，展示厂商、上下文长度及官方输入/输出单价，并支持厂商筛选和排序。
价格数据保留厂商官方计价币种与来源链接，不再强制换算成人民币。
完善模型目录、套餐与模型关联及模型图标，让模型与厂商归属更清晰。
items_en: Browse subscription plans by model to see which plans include each model.
Compare providers, context windows, and official input/output prices on the dedicated model page, with provider filters and sorting.
Prices retain each provider's official billing currency and source links instead of being forcibly converted to CNY.
Improved the model catalog, plan-to-model relationships, and model icons for clearer vendor attribution.

entries.title: 新增 4 个品牌、21 个套餐
entries.summary: CreditsPlan 新增收录 Claude、ChartGPT、Google Antigravity、Grok 4 个 AI 编程品牌，累计 8 个品牌、33 个套餐。
entries.summary_en: CreditsPlan adds Claude, ChartGPT, Google Antigravity, and Grok, bringing the total to 8 brands and 33 plans.
items: 新增 Claude 品牌：Free / Pro / Max 5x / Max 20x / Team Standard / Team Premium / Enterprise 共 7 个套餐
新增 ChartGPT 品牌：Free / Go / Plus / Pro / Pro 20x / Business 共 6 个套餐
新增 Google Antigravity 品牌：Individual / Google AI Pro / Google AI Ultra 5x / Google AI Ultra 20x 共 4 个套餐
新增 Grok 品牌：SuperGrok Lite / SuperGrok / SuperGrok Heavy / Grok Business 共 4 个套餐
items_en: New Claude brand: Free / Pro / Max 5x / Max 20x / Team Standard / Team Premium / Enterprise — 7 plans
New ChartGPT brand: Free / Go / Plus / Pro / Pro 20x / Business — 6 plans
New Google Antigravity brand: Individual / Google AI Pro / Google AI Ultra 5x / Google AI Ultra 20x — 4 plans
New Grok brand: SuperGrok Lite / SuperGrok / SuperGrok Heavy / Grok Business — 4 plans

entries.title: CreditsPlan 正式上线
entries.summary: CreditsPlan 完成首批 AI 编程品牌与套餐数据收录，面向国际用户正式上线。首批上线 4 个品牌、12 个套餐。
entries.summary_en: CreditsPlan completes its initial AI Coding brand and plan data collection, officially launching for international users. Launching with 4 brands and 12 plans.
items: 首批上线 4 个 AI 编程品牌：Qoder、BytePlus、Z.ai、OpenCode
收录 12 个套餐完整数据：Qoder（Community / Pro / Pro+ / Ultra / Teams / Enterprise）、BytePlus（Lite / Pro）、Z.ai GLM Coding（Lite / Pro / Max）、OpenCode Go
支持中英文双语浏览，套餐价格与额度对比一目了然
提供品牌专属 SEO 页面，方便搜索引擎收录
支持套餐价格变动追踪与历史对比
items_en: Launching with 4 AI Coding brands: Qoder, BytePlus, Z.ai, OpenCode
12 plans with full data: Qoder (Community / Pro / Pro+ / Ultra / Teams / Enterprise), BytePlus (Lite / Pro), Z.ai GLM Coding (Lite / Pro / Max), OpenCode Go
Bilingual (Chinese & English) browsing with side-by-side plan price and quota comparison
Brand-specific SEO pages for better search engine visibility
Plan price change tracking and historical comparison
